data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m ($1.9m net of reinsurance).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 was $788.767m. During 2020 there was a small net adverse prior-year reserve movement: gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m. The deterioration was concentrated in older years (2017 & prior) primarily from the Casualty division, with additional smaller deterioration in Property/Fire and Aviation due to late-developing large losses, partially offset by favourable experience on 2018 in shorter-tailed Technical Risks and Accident & Health. Direct COVID-19 exposure is considered small at present.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2020, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2018 and prior) increased by $0.6m ($1.9m net of reinsurance).
The older years (2017 & prior) have seen deteriorations coming primarily from the Casualty division, but also PFR and Aviation to a smaller extent, in respect of late deteriorating large losses.
This has been offset by better than expected experience on 2018 from some of the shorter tailed lines within the Technical Risks division and Accident & Health division.

Whilst COVID-19 contributes additional uncertainties to the Syndicate's claim reserves, we do not expect these to have a significant impact on Syndicate 1919. The Syndicate considers its direct COVID-19 claims exposure at this stage to be less than $2m net of reinsurance, as few claims have been notified to date, with many denied on coverage grounds.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are presented in the report's native currency (USD) and are in millions. The key names (e.g. opening_reserves_gbp_m) use the standard field name but values are USD. Prior year movement is taken from an explicit narrative sentence giving the gross movement ($0.6m gross). No single-line 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross reconciliation table was provided with a clear gross movement number beyond the narrative; a gross claims development triangle is present but the PDF-extracted table was not parsed reliably for numerical extraction, so the triangle was not used to recompute PYD. LOB-level prior year movement amounts are not quantified in the report and are therefore left null.

_claims_triangle.note: A gross claims development triangle (cumulative incurred) appears on page 48 but the PDF-extracted layout was not reliably parseable into a clean numeric matrix; development rows omitted here for data quality reasons.
